blocks.html:
The commissioner may waive the requirements of this chapter for the alteration of existing
buildings, provided, however, that such waiver would not significantly adversely affect provisions for health, safety and security and
that equally safe and proper alternatives are prescribed and, further, that such waiver is based upon a specific finding that strict
compliance with the requirement:
1. Would create an undue economic burden;
2. Would not achieve its intended objective;
3. Would be physically or legally impossible;
4. Would be unnecessary in light of alternatives which ensure the achievement of the intended objective or which, without a
loss in the level of safety, achieve the intended objective more efficiently, effectively or economically; or
5. Would entail a change so slight as to produce a negligible additional benefit consonant with the purposes of this chapter.
